value.title: adopt-is-consent
value.summary: Registration stamps delivery consent: adopting a Claude seat into pij IS the consent act (Jordan 2026-09-01), so every adopted/hand-started seat gets full-body socket delivery instead of pointer turns.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Today cross_session_inbound_accept is derived only from spawn argv; the registration/adopt path stamps nothing, so every hand-started Claude seat has NULL and can_deliver (crates/transport/src/uds.rs:170-178) refuses the socket rung — pointers forever. Ruling 2026-09-01 (governance rulings/2026-09-01-adopt-is-consent.md): adopt IS consent. Stamp Some(true) at Claude registration/adopt + backfill existing rows. Lineage: oq-1104 mirror gap (PR #330 review), oq-1101 default (resolved by ruling), req-0008 family. Brief: governance briefs/s121-register-reads-consent.md (amended by excision same day).

sections.name: goals
value: Claude seat registration/adopt stamps cross_session_inbound_accept=Some(true) on the descriptor
Backfill migration: existing non-tombstoned Claude rows with NULL become Some(true)
An adopted, hand-started Claude seat receives a full message body as a real turn with no store hack
pij still NEVER emits from-mode=bypass (uds.rs:925 pin stands)

sections.name: non_goals
value: Recipient-side crossSessionInbound setting (operator act; handled by 2026-08-31 ruling via settings)
req-0018 reaping (dead-pane rows may receive the stamp — harmless: can_deliver also needs a discoverable session record, which a dead pane lacks; reaping tombstones them later)

value.text: Adopt a hand-started Claude seat (real pane, CLI running with crossSessionInbound accept): a pij send to it lands as a real type=user turn — witnessed live in the pane, not a unit test

Control on the same build: a seat whose recipient CLI lacks the accept setting still receives (frame sent) but is HELD by the harness — proving pij asserted nothing (both worlds emit a positive artifact)
An explicit Some(false) on a row is never overwritten by registration or backfill (test separates NULL-at-adopt from Some(false)-later)
Backfill is idempotent and skips tombstoned rows; running it twice changes zero additional rows
Test pinning absence of from-mode in emitted frames still passes unmodified (uds.rs:925)
pij-gate all stages green; typecheck green; vitest green modulo the known pre-existing npm-resolution failure

value.title: Phase 1 — stamp + backfill + witness
value.brief: Single unit; PM codes it itself per pij-team (no fan-out), reviewer after.
